people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Aroer
people.line: A city on the edge of the Arnon Valley.

people.name: Dibon
people.line: Moabite city, allotted to Gad, later possessed by Moab.

people.name: Medeba
people.line: A Moabite city captured by the Israelites

translations.web: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;
translations.bsb: The area from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the middle of the valley, the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,
translations.kjv: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
